**Finding: compliant (preferred level).**

- **Section 14.3 "Liquidated Damages" (p0668, continuing at p0671)** is directional in our favour: it is triggered by Array's conduct (concealment/falsification of material safety or efficacy data) and gives Ono the election to continue the Agreement, be relieved of diligence obligations, and apply a reduced royalty rate as liquidated damages. Per the detection guidance, LDs payable by Vendor to Customer are compliant and are not flagged.
- **No Customer-payable stipulated amount exists elsewhere.** Section 13.2 permits Ono to terminate without cause on advance notice with no exit fee or minimum payment; Sections 13.3–13.5 attach no payment on termination; Article XIV imposes transition obligations but no termination fee. Searches for "penalty", "termination fee", "minimum annual payment", "non-refundable" and "damages" returned nothing payable by Ono as liquidated damages.
- The only Ono payments (upfront fee, milestones, royalties, and the Declined Clinical Study cost reimbursement at p0298) are consideration or actual-cost reimbursements, not penalties.

No redline proposed.
